summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and appended the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with all eleven members and their string values, each with a comment on meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(region_name, service_name, s3_config, endpoint_bridge, client_endpoint_url, legacy_endpoint_url), which reuses the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3 and STS predicates. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) covering every behavioral criterion, with the S3 predicate test asserting one call. Results: test_args.py, test_regions.py and test_client.py pass (412 tests). The full tests/unit run has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py; the same 11 fail on the untouched baseline, so they predate this change. No commit was made.
